name: Actix Web
workers: Default: one worker per available CPU (2)

phase2.validation: web::Path, web::Query, web::Json and web::Form extractors (type errors 400; a non-integer id 404, PathConfig's default); ranges checked by hand (422)

csrf.mechanism: actix-csrf 0.8 (double-submit cookie: random token in the __Host-Csrf-Token cookie, echoed in the form; Csrf<Form<_>> extractor)

session.mechanism: actix-session 0.11 CookieSessionStore (private cookie, key shared by the workers)
